title: Paris, France
description: Cycled through the French countryside and arrived in Paris in the evening. The Eiffel Tower lit up at night as I rolled into the city. Croissants for dinner — absolutely earned.

title: Lyon, France
description: The Rhône valley opened up beautifully today. Long descents through vineyards, warmth in the air. Lyon is stunning — old stone and the two rivers meeting.

title: London, UK
description: Day 1 — The journey begins! Rolled out of London on a crisp morning, heart hammering with excitement and nerves. The city slowly gave way to the Surrey Hills. Everything felt surreal.

title: Dover, UK
description: Made it to the coast! 130km in the legs. Watched the white cliffs glow in the afternoon sun before catching the ferry. France tomorrow.

title: Milan, Italy
description: Crossed the Alps via Mont Cenis — brutal but breathtaking. The descent into Italy with snow-capped peaks behind me was one of the best moments of my life.
